children: The cost of insuring euro-denominated credit against default rises due to reduced risk appetite as U.S.-Iran hostilities intensify. The U.S. destroyed Iranian oil tankers on Tuesday in response to Iran's attempts to strike U.S. warships. Renewed tensions caused oil prices to climb above $100 per barrel and lowered appetite for risk. The iTraxx Europe Crossover index of euro high-yield credit default swaps rises 2 basis points to 253bps, a three-week high, S&P Global Market Intelligence data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
